symptom: Merging main into a task causes megabytes of already remote commits to be reviewed.
direct_cause: Exclusion relies on optional origin/HEAD rather than all origin tracking refs; new refs use endpoint diff.
class_root: The push review boundary must exclude every commit already reachable from origin tracking refs and the advertised destination tip.
invariants: All push creation and update reviews share authored commit selection; Git failure blocks review.
New-ref binary summaries begin at the first authored commit parent, never an unrelated remote tip.
generality_proof: All origin refs are enumerated independently of symbolic HEAD, and advertised tip stays excluded when tracking is stale.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Select and size authored patches for new and existing refs.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Now routes to the same authored selection

recurrence.reason: Every worktree lacking origin/HEAD can import main history into review.
same_class_scan: Read collectReviewDiff new and existing ref branches and authoredCommits; rg merge rev-list new ref in hook and node tests.

prevention.invariant: Exclude all origin tracking commits before rendering per-commit patches.
prevention.failure_mode: Git errors and oversized units throw actionable blocking errors.
prevention.strategy: One authored selector across push entry points.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed origin HEAD-only exclusion and new-ref endpoint review.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Installed Git already implements required reachability and combined diff semantics; no package change.

migration: No persisted data changes; existing refs work without symbolic remote HEAD.
residual_risks: Dense combined diff does not report resolutions choosing one parent unchanged.
